verification.notes: A 2026 book by journalist Florian Tardif alleges that Brigitte Macron pushed or slapped Emmanuel Macron after seeing messages involving actress Golshifteh Farahani. Brigitte Macron and her entourage categorically denied that account. The incident is visible on video, but the claimed motive remains disputed rather than established fact.
